notes_for_editor: The 1935 build date, CCC attribution, 100-ft height and 'Deer Lake Farm' name come only from the Minnesota tower list. Checked on the list: the 1959 figures (four-legged, 125 ft) sit inside the Deer Lake entry, before the Deer Town entry begins, so they belong to Deer Lake. Agency is not stated in any source read, so it is left out (the list says the state forest service built a small farm near the site, which is not the same claim). Brief record: agency null, ownership unknown; no correction. Unlinked lead only: deerlakewatershed.org describes a CCC camp S-95 historic site; nothing it says ties it to this tower, so it is not used. Searches: 2 WebSearch-equivalent calls. Reads: 4 distinct pages that were used or checked; a Star Tribune fetch returned HTTP 429 and was skipped.
